title: When the Extraction Breaks
author: Marguerite Lockridge
blurb: Rosalind Nystrom, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, has spent fifteen years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must trade the one secret worth killing for before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
